5 تشبّع He ate immediately after eating. (K.) ―
-b2- He feigned himself satiated, sated, or satisfied in stomach, not being so. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- [And hence,] (tropical:) He made a boast of abundance or riches, (Msb, K, * TA,) or of more than he possessed; and invested himself with that which did not belong to him. (TA.) [See مُتَشَبِّعٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
